descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
You let yourself get captured. Now the real mission begins.

A rebel army led by Colonel Walker has seized a remote island in the Pacific and turned an ancient fortress into its base of operations. Its underground dungeons are being used as prison cells, while heavily armed soldiers control the island.

As an elite Green Beret, getting captured was the only way inside.

Escape from your cell, recover your weapons and fight your way through the fortress, its dungeons and the surrounding enemy positions. Eliminate the rebel forces, dismantle Colonel Walker's operation and find a way off the island alive.

Green Beret is a virtual reality first-person shooter inspired by classic action games and old-school military shooters.

• Escape from an enemy prison
• Fight your way through a heavily defended fortress
• Face armed soldiers in intense VR firefights
• Explore dungeons, military positions and enemy-controlled areas
• Use different weapons to survive the mission
• Experience classic FPS action rebuilt for virtual reality

Get in. Complete the mission. Get out alive.
